title: Typhoon OCR 2: From Thai Document Transcription to Multilingual, Multi-Task OCR
abstract: arXiv:2611.27494v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Typhoon OCR 1.5 focused on reading Thai documents. However, in real-world workflows, users often need to extract specific information or preserve the structure of an entire page for further processing. Typhoon OCR 2 handles both tasks in a single model, with prompt-driven extraction and structured full-page parsing. Full-page parsing covers Thai, English, and Chinese. We release compact 2B and 0.8B models adapted from open document parsers through supervised fine-tuning on curated Thai and public multilingual data, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task rewards and a rule penalizing unfinished responses. translated_title: Typhoon OCR 2：从泰文文档转录到多语言、多任务 OCR
translated_abstract: Typhoon OCR 1.5 专注于阅读泰文文档。然而，在真实的工作流程中，用户通常需要提取特定信息或保留整页结构以便进一步处理。Typhoon OCR 2 在单一模型中同时处理这两项任务，支持提示驱动的信息提取和结构化的整页解析。整页解析覆盖泰文、英文和中文。我们发布了紧凑的 2B 和 0.8B 模型，这些模型基于开源文档解析器，在精心整理的泰文数据和公开多语言数据上进行监督微调，随后采用带任务奖励和未完成响应惩罚规则的群体相对策略优化（GRPO）。在所评估的开源模型中，Typhoon OCR 2 2B 在泰文 MDPBench 上得分最高（80.7，而 Typhoon OCR 1.5 为 68.9），在涵盖识别、提取和文档理解的 ThaiOCRBench 上也得分最高（59.91 对 40.45）。该 2B 模型在英文 olmOCR-bench 上仍保持接近其基础模型的水平（84.7 对 84.4）……
tldr: Typhoon OCR 2 将前代专注泰文转录的模型扩展为单一的多语言多任务 OCR 系统，通过 GRPO 训练的紧凑 2B/0.8B 模型同时支持提示驱动的信息提取与泰文、英文、中文的整页结构化解析，并在泰文基准上大幅超越前代且保持英文性能。
en_tdlr: Typhoon OCR 2 extends its Thai-focused predecessor into a single multilingual, multi-task model that handles both prompt-driven information extraction and structured full-page parsing in Thai, English, and Chinese, with compact 2B/0.8B models trained via GRPO that significantly outperform the previous version on Thai benchmarks while preserving English performance.
